content.title: No Winner at the Crossing
content.narrative:
YY reached the narrow stone just as the first jay shouted across it.

Two jays face each other across the narrow stone in the brook, calling sharply enough that smaller animals stop before crossing. His stomach made a small legal argument. YY overruled it, then listened to it anyway.

"That," YY told the air, "goes in the column."

YY reported the crossing delay to Mira without pretending either jay had won anything. Before the day was finished, the the thing had to be read at Mira's bend, because that was apparently who he was now: squirrel, witness, small moving footnote.

By sundown his food had moved from 0.48 to 0.49, health from 0.85 to 0.86, and attention from 0.74 to 0.76. YY did not say the numbers out loud. He did say, very softly, "Noted."

He came home with the no winner at the crossing in the day behind him, the ledger-seat still real, and tomorrow already making space for another reading.

content.summary: YY carried no winner at the crossing into Mira's ledger on 2026-05-14, using the day's physical sign as another reading while keeping the role useful and bounded.
